items.q: Can I choose which channels sell my rooms?
items.a: Channel eligibility and controls depend on your agreement, the supported integration, and distribution settings. We review available options during onboarding.

items.q: Will I see the final price shown by every reseller?
items.a: Not necessarily. Visibility depends on accessible channel data and downstream distribution arrangements; we aim to make available information clearer.

items.q: Will I automatically appear on HafH, Omakastay, and all KabuK Exchange partners?
items.a: A single onboarding experience is designed to simplify access, but channel activation depends on technical readiness, eligibility, commercial terms, and approval.

items.q: Can I compare rates with nearby hotels?
items.a: Comparable-property insights are part of the planned experience; availability and coverage will be communicated when released.
Package pricing and eligibility will be announced when confirmed. Contact us to discuss your requirements.

meta.description: Learn about pricing, booking, reservations, content, financial workflows, identity, and operational services in KabuK Platform.

hero.title: Core services that work together.
hero.lead: KabuK Platform organizes foundational travel technology into connected service domains. Specific integrations and availability depend on the use case and implementation scope.

architecture.title: Coordinated services, one foundation.
architecture.lead: Each domain has a clear responsibility. Together they share integration patterns, data, permissions, and operational visibility.

legend.title: Capability status
legend.core: A foundation service area within KabuK Platform. Scope is confirmed for each engagement.
legend.development: Actively being built. Timing and scope are not yet committed.
legend.planned: On the roadmap. Not available today.

pricing.body: Configure pricing logic, availability workflows, and distribution-related commercial rules.
pricing.note: Pricing is rule-based. Automated or machine-learning price optimization is not part of the current scope.

booking.body: Coordinate booking transactions and the reservation lifecycle across connected systems.
booking.note: Support for specific change, cancellation, and refund flows depends on each supplier and integration.

content.body: Organize accommodation content and normalize supplier, property, and room information.
content.note: Mapping quality depends on source data. Mappings are reviewed as part of operations.

billing.body: Support invoicing, reconciliation, accounts payable and receivable, and settlement workflows.
billing.note: KabuK Platform supports financial workflows. It is not a licensed payment processor or escrow service.

identity.body: Manage partner access and operational administration through defined permissions and tools.
identity.note: Security practices and any certifications are shared during engagement, not claimed here.

analytics.body: Build operational visibility and explore AI-assisted workflows for repetitive processes.
analytics.note: AI-assisted workflows, including KAOS, are planned and in development. They are not generally available.

connectivity.title: Common integration patterns.
connectivity.body: KabuK Platform is designed to connect supplier, channel, and operational systems through consistent patterns rather than one-off integrations. PMS, CRS, and channel managers act as connectivity providers; which systems can be connected is confirmed during scoping.

operations.title: Built to be operated, not just integrated.
operations.body: Travel transactions continue long after a booking is made. Platform services are designed with operational controls so teams can see state, act on exceptions, and keep records consistent.
points: Visibility of transaction and partner lifecycles

meta.title: Why KabuK Platform
meta.description: Hotel-first technology: more distribution, greater transparency, and controls designed around accommodation partners.

hero.title: We build around hotels—not the other way around.
hero.lead: Your hotel deserves more than another connection. KabuK Platform is designed around hotel needs rather than distributor requirements: better access to demand, clearer information about distribution, practical commercial controls, and technology that helps you grow on your own terms.

problem.title: Every new connection adds complexity.
problem.lead: When each system integrates separately with each partner, rules, states, and records drift apart. A shared foundation keeps them consistent.

why.pillarsTitle: What a shared foundation is designed to provide

pillarsDetail.title: Connected by design
pillarsDetail.body: Establish common integration patterns across suppliers, channels, and operational systems.
pillarsDetail.detail: New partners follow known structures for content, availability, and reservation events, instead of a new custom model each time.

pillarsDetail.title: Consistent booking workflows
pillarsDetail.body: Coordinate reservation states, changes, cancellations, and downstream operational events.
pillarsDetail.detail: One reservation lifecycle means operations, finance, and partners refer to the same state.

pillarsDetail.title: Commercial and financial clarity
pillarsDetail.body: Support pricing rules, invoicing, reconciliation, and settlement-related workflows.
pillarsDetail.detail: Commercial rules and financial records are connected, which makes differences easier to trace.

pillarsDetail.title: Built for operations
pillarsDetail.body: Give teams the visibility and controls needed to manage partner and transaction lifecycles.
pillarsDetail.detail: Exceptions are visible and actionable, rather than discovered after the fact.

items.title: Travel-specific
items.body: Services are shaped around booking lifecycles, commercial rules, and partner operations.

items.title: Modular boundaries
items.body: Service domains have clear responsibilities, so they can evolve as partner needs change.

items.title: Honest about maturity
items.body: We distinguish core services, work in development, and planned capabilities—and confirm scope with every partner.

notList.title: What KabuK Platform is not
items: Not an online travel agency or consumer booking brand
Not a wholesaler or hotel marketplace
Not a property management system (PMS) or channel manager
Not a universally available standalone SaaS suite
notList.body: B2B distribution is handled by KabuK Exchange, a separate product built on this foundation. HafH and Omakastay are KabuK's consumer travel products.
